hypothesis: Without knowing source regime, a public-TRAIN learned mixture weight between a compositional causal-rule prior and an unrestricted 256-rule prior can update its posterior model probability as observations arrive, transferring structural predictions to unfamiliar atom pairings while avoiding materially worse Brier forecasts on unrestricted laws.
new_operator: Fit scalar compositional mixture prior pi in [0.05,0.95] by four unsupervised EM updates over public meta TRAIN 4-bit observations. Given observation mask/output, compute exact Bayes factor L_comp/L_full and update pi_observed = pi*L_comp/(pi*L_comp+(1-pi)*L_full). Future distribution is pi_observed times exact compositional predictive P plus (1-pi_observed) times exact unrestricted predictive P. Learned pi must materially change predictions versus fixed pi=0.5 or disabled pi=0 on disjoint TRAIN validation.

source_free_regimes.nature: Algebraic TRAIN-only causal-rule source, not new unknown graph scientifically prospective cohort
source_free_regimes.gates: All 16 two-input Boolean atoms in both G/H roles; three operators XOR,AND,OR; 768 syntactic programs with shared 3-input truth tables
source_free_regimes.VALIDATION_structured_pair_partition: (G+3*H)%4==0; 64 disjoint pairs, complete reuse of exposed gate atoms
source_free_regimes.source_training_atom_role_coverage: Force first 16 structured META G=i and H=(i+1)%16; both roles cover 0..15, all pairs satisfy (G+3H)%4=3
source_free_regimes.unrestricted_law_source: Uniform 0..255 full three-input Boolean truth table; no gate program or latent source-regime label presented to candidate
source_free_regimes.private_regime_labels: Withheld from all model fitting and inference; source evaluator uses them only for stratified scoring and source identity audits
source_free_regimes.public_queries_at_each_checkpoint: All eight causal input patterns; exact hard certifications only for previously observed truth-table entries; probability Brier on unobserved targets only

fitting_fairness: Full256 categorical and factor compositional both receive identical public meta observations and four EM rounds with nonzero smoothing. Fixed mixture uses full 768 compositional prior and full 256 base; all posterior likelihoods normalized and exact. Source labels are unavailable to models.
exact_safety: An independent all-256-version-space oracle reconstructs every public bit observation and every future query; hard certifications must be implied by all unrestricted consistent truth tables. No nonzero confidence is interpreted as certainty.
future_science_boundary: Even if TRAIN validation passes, fresh *scientific* unfamiliar graph/cohort source birth requires separate preregistration, new source IDs and independent one-time source custody. Do not treat source-free TRAIN validation as first-use evidence.
